magician: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat and everyone cheered.
魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子,大家都欢呼起来。
all kinds of: The shop sells all kinds of fruits from many different countries.
这家商店出售来自许多国家的各种各样的水果。
beautifully: She sings beautifully, so we all enjoy listening to her songs.
她唱歌很好听,我们都喜欢听她的歌。
be up to: It is up to you to decide where we will go this weekend.
这个周末我们去哪儿由你决定。
play a role: Teachers play a role in shaping how students think about learning.
教师在塑造学生对学习的看法方面发挥着作用。
make up: He made up an interesting story to make his little sister laugh.
他编了一个有趣的故事逗妹妹笑。
for example: You can try many sports here, for example, swimming and basketball.
例如,你可以在这里尝试游泳和篮球等许多运动。
seriously: He was seriously hurt in the accident and had to stay in hospital.
他在事故中受了重伤,不得不住院治疗。
take…seriously: You should take your teacher's advice seriously if you want to improve.
如果你想进步,就应该认真对待老师的建议。
sitcom: My favorite sitcom makes me laugh every time I watch it.
我最喜欢的情景喜剧每次看都会让我大笑。
situation comedy: A situation comedy usually tells funny stories about everyday life.
情景喜剧通常讲述日常生活中的搞笑故事。
soap opera: My grandmother watches her favorite soap opera every afternoon.
我奶奶每天下午都看她最喜欢的肥皂剧。
find out: I want to find out when the train leaves for Beijing.
我想弄清楚去北京的火车什么时候出发。
action movie: We watched an exciting action movie at the cinema last night.
我们昨晚在电影院看了一部刺激的动作片。
The comedy we saw last week made the whole audience laugh.
我们上周看的那部喜剧让全场观众都笑了。
unlucky: He was unlucky to miss the last bus home last night.
他昨晚很不幸,错过了回家的末班车。
be ready to: She is always ready to help her classmates with their homework.
她总是乐于帮助同学做作业。
dress up: The children dressed up as animals for the school party.
孩子们在学校晚会上装扮成了动物。
take sb.’s place: Nobody can take her place on the team because she plays so well.
没有人能替代她在队里的位置,因为她打得非常好。
do a good job: You did a good job cleaning the classroom today.
你今天打扫教室干得很好。
grow up: What do you want to be when you grow up?
computer programmer: His brother works as a computer programmer in a big company.
他哥哥在一家大公司当程序员。
be sure about: I am sure about my plan to study abroad next year.
我对明年出国留学的计划很有把握。
make sure: Please make sure all the windows are closed before you leave.
离开前请确保所有窗户都关好了。
be able to: After months of practice, he was able to swim very well.
经过几个月的练习,他已经能游得很好了。
at the beginning of: We usually make plans at the beginning of the new year.
我们通常在新年伊始制定计划。
write down: Please write down your name and phone number on this form.
请把你的名字和电话号码写在这张表格上。
have to do with: His job has to do with computers and the Internet.
他的工作与电脑和互联网有关。
self-improvement: Reading good books is a helpful way of self-improvement for everyone.
阅读好书对每个人来说都是一种有益的自我提高方式。
take up: My father took up photography as a hobby last year.
我爸爸去年开始把摄影当作一种爱好。
school work: She spends two hours on her school work every evening.
她每天晚上花两个小时做学校作业。
agree with: I agree with you that the movie was too long.
我同意你的看法,这部电影太长了。
play a part: Everyone should play a part in keeping our city clean.
每个人都应该参与到保持城市清洁中来。
space station: The astronauts lived on the space station for six months.
宇航员在空间站上生活了六个月。
over and over again: He read the poem over and over again until he could remember it.
他反复读那首诗,直到能背下来为止。
hundreds of: Hundreds of people joined the concert in the park last Saturday.
上周六数百人参加了公园里的音乐会。
fall down: The little boy fell down and hurt his knee while running.
小男孩跑步时摔倒了,伤了膝盖。
milk shake: She made a banana milk shake for breakfast this morning.
她今天早上做了一杯香蕉奶昔当早餐。
blender: Put the fruit and milk into the blender and mix them well.
把水果和牛奶放进搅拌机里搅拌均匀。
turn on: Could you turn on the TV? The news starts at seven.
你能打开电视吗?新闻七点开始。
